privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how White-Shop (“we”, “us”) collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use our website and services.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: White-Shop is an online store operating in Armenia. You can reach us through the Contact page or the email address shown in the site footer.

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect
paragraphs: We may collect your name, email, phone number, shipping/billing address, order and payment details, account data, contact-form messages, and technical data (IP address, browser type, device information) needed to operate and secure the service.
If you register or sign in, we also keep account status, session data, and preferences such as language and currency.

sections.heading: 3. Why we process data
paragraphs: We process data to place and fulfill orders, handle payments and accounting, create and manage accounts, provide support, maintain security and prevent fraud, and meet legal obligations.

sections.heading: 4. Sharing
paragraphs: We may share data with service providers (hosting, email, payments, delivery) when needed to fulfill an order or run the site.
We do not sell your personal data. We may disclose data when required by law or a competent authority.

sections.heading: 5. Retention
paragraphs: We keep personal data only as long as needed to provide the service and meet legal and accounting requirements.

When you delete your account, profile, address, wishlist, and cart data are anonymized or removed. Financial order records may be retained for the legally required period without unnecessary personal contact details.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access to your data, correction, restriction of processing, or account deletion through profile tools or by contacting us.
If you believe your rights have been violated, you may also contact the competent personal-data authority in Armenia.

sections.heading: 7. Security and cookies
paragraphs: We apply technical and organizational measures to protect data from unauthorized access. No system is fully secure, but we work to reduce risks.
The site may use necessary cookies and similar technologies for sign-in sessions, language/currency preferences, and security.

sections.heading: 8. Contact
paragraphs: For privacy questions, use the Contact page or the email and phone listed in the footer.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By using the White-Shop website and placing an order, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

sections.heading: 1. Service description
paragraphs: White-Shop provides an online catalog, cart, checkout, delivery or pickup, and customer account tools. Site content may change without prior notice.

sections.heading: 2. Accounts
paragraphs: You must provide accurate information and keep your login credentials confidential. You are responsible for activity under your account.
We may suspend or restrict an account in cases of fraud, abuse, or breach of these terms.

sections.heading: 3. Orders, pricing, and availability
paragraphs: Product prices, discounts, and availability are shown on the site and may change until an order is confirmed. An order is accepted when we confirm and/or begin processing it.
If an item is unavailable or priced incorrectly, we may cancel the order or offer an alternative after notifying you.

sections.heading: 4. Payment
paragraphs: The primary payment method is currently Cash on Delivery (COD), unless another method is enabled on the site. The order total includes product prices, applicable discounts, and delivery fees (if any).

sections.heading: 5. Delivery and pickup
paragraphs: Delivery and pickup terms are described in the Delivery Policy. You must provide accurate address and contact details.

sections.heading: 6. Returns and refunds
paragraphs: Return and refund rules are set out in the Refund Policy.

sections.heading: 7. Intellectual property
paragraphs: Site design, text, logos, and other content are protected. You may not copy or reuse them for commercial purposes without our written consent.

sections.heading: 8. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. Our total liability for a claim is limited to the amount of the related order, except where the law requires otherwise.

sections.heading: 9. Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Armenia. Disputes are resolved through negotiation and, if needed, before competent courts in Armenia.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
paragraphs: For questions, use the Contact page or the details in the footer.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: This policy explains how to request a product return or refund from White-Shop.

sections.heading: 1. General principles
paragraphs: We want you to be satisfied with your purchase. If you received a wrong, damaged, or defective item, contact us as soon as possible with your order number and a description of the issue.

sections.heading: 2. When returns are allowed
paragraphs: Returns are generally possible if the product does not match the order, was damaged in transit, or has a manufacturing defect.
Items should be in resalable condition with original packaging and labels, unless safety or hygiene rules require otherwise.

sections.heading: 3. Limitations
paragraphs: Some items may not be returnable, such as personal-hygiene products, custom-made items, or goods that have been opened or used in a way that prevents resale.
Return conditions for discounted or promotional items may differ and will be noted on the product or order when applicable.

sections.heading: 4. How to request a return
paragraphs: Contact us via the Contact page or by phone, including your order number, the product, and a description of the issue. We may ask for photos.
After approval, we will explain the return method and timing.

sections.heading: 5. Refunds
paragraphs: If a refund is approved, funds are returned using the original payment method or another agreed method. For Cash on Delivery (COD), the refund method is arranged separately.
Processing usually takes several business days after approval, depending on the payment method and banking timelines.

sections.heading: 6. Order cancellation
paragraphs: If an order has not yet shipped, you may request cancellation by contacting us. If the order is already in transit or delivered, standard return rules apply.

delivery.title: Delivery Policy
delivery.intro: This policy describes White-Shop delivery and pickup terms.

sections.heading: 1. Delivery area
paragraphs: We primarily serve the Republic of Armenia according to active delivery zones and rules on the site. Available locations are shown during checkout.

sections.heading: 2. Delivery methods
paragraphs: Depending on available options, you may choose address delivery or pickup from a designated point. The cost and estimated timing for each method appear at checkout.

sections.heading: 3. Fees and timing
paragraphs: Delivery fees are calculated from the selected zone/rule. Some zones may offer a free-delivery threshold.
Estimated delivery days are indicative and may change due to stock, weather, or other operational reasons. We will notify you of material delays.

sections.heading: 4. Address and contact
paragraphs: You must provide an accurate address and a working phone number. Failed delivery caused by an incorrect address or unavailability may require an extra fee or rescheduling.

sections.heading: 5. Receipt and inspection
paragraphs: On receipt, please check the outer condition of the package. If you notice damage or a mismatch, tell the courier and contact us immediately with your order number.

sections.heading: 6. Failed delivery
paragraphs: If delivery fails because you were unavailable, we will try to contact you to reschedule. A repeat delivery may be chargeable under the applicable rules.

sections.heading: 7. Contact
paragraphs: For delivery questions, use the Contact page or footer details and include your order number.
